output: SELECT city, member_id, trips FROM (SELECT s.city AS city, t.member_id AS member_id, COUNT(*) AS trips, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, t.member_id ASC) AS rn FROM trip t JOIN station s ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id GROUP BY s.city, t.member_id) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY city;
